'''Sestina''' was a celestial body<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> located in the [[Sestina system/Legends|Sestina system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], financiers representing Sestina were part of the [[steering committee]]&mdash;a group of [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], lobbyists, industrialists, financiers, and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designers allied with the [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] financial group.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sestina was mentioned in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Plagueis" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sestina [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
